thread:
ana: Quick sync — planning a 5% canary for the new console hidden-settings exposure. Goal: internal beta + a tiny pilot before we widen exposure. Need owners for guardrails, metrics, and rollback plan. :eyes:

samir: Sounds good. Flag name I'm proposing: `console.hidden_settings.v1`. We'll use the rollout service. Canary bucket = 5% internal orgs, whitelist for beta-admins. Need a tiny PR to add the flag and a migration for the role mapping.

maria: Metrics to track: toggle click-through, settings page p95, backend 5xx on settings write, and user-visible errors. Also track adoption by org id for pilot reporting.

jamal: Agree on metrics. Suggest alerting if error rate > 1% over 5m or if p95 latency jumps > 200ms vs baseline. Also add a log tag `feature=hidden_settings_canary` so we can filter quickly.

olivia: I'll prep the UX copy and a small devex note for the console: tooltip + an "Opt in to beta" path for beta-admins. Also recommend we hide it behind the account-level "Beta features" toggle so customers don't accidentally see it.

samir: One more ops note — we should lock the canary to internal orgs first (redwood-internal + partners). After 48 hours with no regressions, ramp to 25% for pilot customers. Need approval from product + SRE.

ana: @samir (typo) sorry meant @maria — @samir @maria can you both review the flag PR? Planning to flip the 5% canary tomorrow 09:00 PT unless we get blockers.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: feature-rollout service will flip `console.hidden_settings.v1` to 5% for internal orgs at 1769457000 UTC. Link: https://deploys.internal/1769457000 (deploy details)

sre-bot: I'll create a dashboard tile for: errors(%), p95 latency, toggle add/remove rate, and a small burn-down for opt-ins. PagerDuty rule proposed: page on errors > 1% for 10m or p95 > baseline + 250ms for 5m.

jamal: I'll draft a short runbook: immediate rollback = flip flag to 0% + announce in #incidents + roll a hotfix if needed. If we see degraded UX but no infra errors, we can constrain to whitelist only.

maria: Docs/PR incoming — will include rollout plan, list of pilot orgs, and the metrics dashboard link. Expect PR by EOD.

olivia: Comms plan: short note in #product + direct email to pilot admins tomorrow once canary is live. We'll call out known limitations and how to opt out.

samir: Code review pinged, small changes left. If nothing else, I'll merge by 08:30 PT and hand over to deploy.

ana: Great — summary: owners: samir (flag/infra), maria (metrics/docs), jamal (runbook/oncall), olivia (UX/comms), sre-bot (monitoring). Canary: 5% internal orgs -> 25% pilot if healthy. Rollback: flip to 0% + announce. Moving to canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:

maria: acked.

jamal: acked, prepping runbook now.

samir: acked, will ping when merged.

deploy-bot: feature-rollout complete: `console.hidden_settings.v1` set to 5% at 1769457000.

sre-bot: Dashboard live: https://grafana.internal/d/hidden-settings-canary (dashboard id 123) — alerts configured.

ana: Thanks everyone — keeping thread open for any issues.
